title: Clearer MCP errors and smaller tool lists
items: The hosted MCP server's errors say what the API said, with hints naming its own tools, and a timeout that is not a duration is a validation error
Names in ?tools= that are no tool group are reported on describe and in the server's instructions; when none is a group, the client's own default list applies
The hosted tool lists are smaller, and describe answers its sections first
The changelog lists SDK 1.31.0, MCP 2.5.0 and the Python and Go SDKs 0.10.1
